name: Arsh Ramgarhia
tagline: Crafting digital experiences where code meets craft.
intro: I'm a Full-Stack Developer who ships systems real businesses run on — live GPS fleet software operating under strict UK/EU transport law, multi-tenant SaaS handling real customer data and real billing, and national-scale admin and reporting systems used daily across India.
longBio: I design, engineer, and ship full-stack systems end to end. React, Next.js, and React Native on the front end; Node.js, Spring Boot, APIs, data architecture, and real-time systems underneath; AWS, Firebase, and Docker throughout. I've built a transport management platform engineered to satisfy UK/EU drivers'-hours and tachograph law, a multi-tenant garage SaaS with tenant isolation enforced at the architecture level, a platform-wide billing and governance console, and the backend plus two web apps running a national volunteer organization's operations across India. I care about the problem the software has to survive, not just whether it runs in a demo.
availability: Open for select freelance & full-time roles

principles.title: Performance is a feature.
principles.body: If it doesn't load in a blink, it doesn't ship. Bundles get audited, queries get profiled, and every animation earns its place.

principles.title: Design is decisions, not decoration.
principles.body: I treat layout, motion, and microcopy as engineering problems. Every shadow, easing curve, and hover state has a reason.

principles.title: Ship the boring scaffolding well.
principles.body: Auth, error handling, accessibility, telemetry — the unglamorous 80% is where great products are quietly won.

principles.title: Code that future-you can read.
principles.body: No clever tricks for clever's sake. Modular, tested, and documented enough that the next dev says 'thank you', not 'why?'.
